note: Exact strings the Python transports send. ssh_* entries are the full exec line (after sudo wrapping); charon_* entries are prefixed with the MCP tool name. Charon put_root uses a timestamped stage name, so it is described in docs/PARITY.md instead.

ssh_put_root: sudo -n bash -c 'set -e; umask 077; d=$(dirname /etc/morpheus/ssl/m_cust_test.key); [ -d "$d" ] || { mkdir -p "$d"; chmod 0700 "$d"; }; cat > /etc/morpheus/ssl/m_cust_test.key.mci-tmp; chown root:root /etc/morpheus/ssl/m_cust_test.key.mci-tmp; chmod 0600 /etc/morpheus/ssl/m_cust_test.key.mci-tmp; mv -f /etc/morpheus/ssl/m_cust_test.key.mci-tmp /etc/morpheus/ssl/m_cust_test.key'
ssh_put_root_trust: sudo -n bash -c 'set -e; umask 077; d=$(dirname /etc/morpheus/ssl/trusted_certs/a.pem); [ -d "$d" ] || { mkdir -p "$d"; chmod 0755 "$d"; }; cat > /etc/morpheus/ssl/trusted_certs/a.pem.mci-tmp; chown root:root /etc/morpheus/ssl/trusted_certs/a.pem.mci-tmp; chmod 0644 /etc/morpheus/ssl/trusted_certs/a.pem.mci-tmp; mv -f /etc/morpheus/ssl/trusted_certs/a.pem.mci-tmp /etc/morpheus/ssl/trusted_certs/a.pem'
ssh_stream_file: bash -c 'f=/var/log/morpheus-certificate-install/R.log; r=/var/log/morpheus-certificate-install/R.rc; i=0; while [ ! -e "$f" ] && [ $i -lt 30 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done; tail -n +1 -F "$f" 2>/dev/null & T=$!; while [ ! -s "$r" ]; do sleep 1; done; sleep 2; kill $T 2>/dev/null; wait $T 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "@@RC=$(cat "$r")"'
list_runs: sudo -k -S -p '' bash -c 'cd /var/log/morpheus-certificate-install 2>/dev/null && for f in *.log; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; r=${f%.log}; echo "$r|$(stat -c %Y "$f")|$(cat "$r.rc" 2>/dev/null)"; done'
list_backups: sudo -k -S -p '' bash -c 'cd /var/lib/morpheus-certificate-install/backups 2>/dev/null && for d in */; do d=${d%/}; echo "@@B $d"; cat "$d/manifest.json" 2>/dev/null; echo; done'
charon_poll_first: [run_command] bash -c 'f=/var/log/morpheus-certificate-install/R.log; r=/var/log/morpheus-certificate-install/R.rc; s=$(stat -c %s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "SIZE=$s"; echo "RC=$(cat "$r" 2>/dev/null)"; [ "$s" -gt 0 ] && tail -c +1 "$f" | head -c $(( s - 0 > 262144 ? 262144 : s - 0 )) | base64 -w0; echo'
